queue.route: Zanuka Hunter — death mark or Zanuka Hunter Beacon
queue.steps: Fight against the Corpus across five Invasion missions by supporting the Grineer to earn a Zanuka Hunter death mark. Then run eligible Corpus missions until Zanuka attacks, or use a Zanuka Hunter Beacon. Defeat it for the missing Blueprint and Receiver.
